newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU grants 15,480 tonnes maize food aid to N. Korea.
newsitem.headline: EU grants 15,480 tonnes maize food aid to N. Korea.

text.p: The European Union agreed the supply of 15,480 tonnes of maize food aid for North Korea at 127.84 ecus a tonne fob, the EU Official Journal said.
A Commission official said the maize is due to be delivered to the port of shipment between July 14 - 27.
The EU food aid maize tender was awarded to Paris-based company Lecureur and will be distributed through the World Food Programme.
The aid is part of a 46.3 million ecus ($53.2 million) programme of rice, maize, vegetable oils and other food products agreed by the European Commission on May 23.
